scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261013T0117-pr85: wall_clock_s=375, total_tokens=1.61M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained plain git repository with one committed README and no dev-graph state; the same init is run twice with identical arguments.
required_observations: after the first init the six content roots, the routing policy, and the graph store exist and the initial graph passes C11
a second init with the same arguments plans 0 changes and preserves user edits
the repo config stores no absolute path, token, or node ID and the plugin hook source is used
